_doc: Per-app metrics (server/app-metrics.mjs). id = snapshot field and market base (<id>_day for counters, <id>_dmed for levels). kind = how it is read. tier = hourly|daily. scale/unit/digits = display. pushCost = what one player must spend to move a day's value by ~10% (cheap < $100, medium, expensive > $10k): only medium/expensive numbers get markets. how = the sentence shown on the market page.

metrics.pushCost: expensive: ~10% of the pool is millions of SOL parked for the whole window
metrics.how: Total JitoSOL in circulation (the liquid-staking token Jito mints for every SOL staked with it), read from the mint's supply on-chain.

metrics.pushCost: expensive: moving the 24-hour median by a few percent means parking tens of thousands of SOL in it for half a day
metrics.how: Total JupSOL in circulation (Jupiter's liquid-staking token), read from the mint's supply on-chain.

metrics.pushCost: medium to expensive: holding the price up for half a day against the pools' depth
metrics.how: ORE/USD from Jupiter's price API (third-party quote), read every hour.
